newsitem.title: UK: New York plans $300 mln FRN early Jan-Goldman Sach.
newsitem.headline: New York plans $300 mln FRN early Jan-Goldman Sach.

text.p: The City of New York will launch a $300 million FRN in early January, a syndicate official at lead manager Goldman Sachs said on Wednesday.
The FRN will have a five-year maturity with a three-year average life as the issue will be amortising, he said.
Market sources said the pricing was expected to be in the 30 basis points area over three-month LIBOR.
Roadshows in London and Frankfurt will take place in the week of January 6.
New York City is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB+ by Standard & Poor's Corp.
The paper will carry a 20.0 percent risk weighting.
In June, New York City launched a $180.5 million four-tranche Eurobond via Citibank.
